description: This Java class 'LwM2MConfigurationChecker' extends 'ConfigurationChecker' and verifies LwM2M bootstrap server configurations, including security settings and server identifiers, ensuring compliance with LwM2M specifications.

classes.name: LwM2MConfigurationChecker
classes.description: A class that verifies LwM2M bootstrap server configurations, focusing on security modes and server identifiers.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Overrides the verify method to check security configurations and server security entries in the bootstrap configuration.

methods.name: validateOneSecurityByServer
methods.description: Validates that each server has a corresponding security entry and that server IDs conform to LwM2M specifications.

methods.name: getSecurityEntry
methods.description: Retrieves the security entry for a given server short ID from the bootstrap configuration.
